pattern: List — insert\(\): ".*" is already a property name on the list or its owner — refused
why: Several real page.js files declare a component/demo child whose name happens to equal a reserved Page/Item property (id, data, view, owner, name, parent, render, initialize, url, app, loaded, content, pages, items, background, icon, depth, overview, files) — ui/page.js's "background"/"icon" are two of ~18. PageChildren.set() (Page.class.js) refuses each safely once per name; nothing breaks, but it is real noise found 2026-10-03 (console-clean task) via a CDP stack trace, not yet root-caused per name. Next step: either rename the colliding children, or teach the collision guard to pick a different id instead of refusing.

pattern: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404.*(spend\.json|usage\.json|tasks\.json|/shots/.*\.png)
why: Old dated ai/ task pages (e.g. ai/2026-09-22/dictate-silence/, ai/2026-09-30/one-dictation/minion-workbench/) link a shot that was never committed, or a per-day spend.json/usage.json/tasks.json that only exists for days a cost or task report actually ran — found 2026-10-04 (dictate-live-state) via merge.mjs's own smoke test, which follows every link on a changed page one hop deep and happened to reach several of these for the first time. Reproduces unchanged on michael/dev today, nothing to do with the diff that surfaced it. Root cause (missing files) is a dated-task-page-rot problem across the whole ai/ tree, not fixable per-page; a real fix would make these optional resources fail silently instead of as a console error.
owner: next mastermind to touch public/framework/ai/ or Server/plugins (shots/spend/usage/tasks fetchers)
